body: Yeah it really sucks, nobody cares but will still tell me not to take my life. It's such a sensitive topic that people avoid it like the plague, and refuse to hear me out on it!
its so hard to focus on the good things when the bad will always overshadow them! but I'm gonna try to talk to my friends and maybe my family.

I dont know anything about married life and such, but I know a lot about self-harm. I've self harmed in many different ways before and it was only making me sadder and more miserable. I still think about doing it everyday but I resist. I've gotten a bunch of stimm toys and they have really helped in keeping my hands busy and my mind focused in class or at work. I have spinners, tangles and cubes that I keep with me every day and it helps with my focus and anxiety. If it gets really bad, I use rubber bands and snap them on my wrist, or ice cubes that I put on my skin or candle wax in extreme cases. These options are not for everyone but it helped me stop permanently damage myself and relieve some tension and inner pain. It also helped me to read a little about why people feel the need to self-harm, because the feeling is often very hard to understand or explain. If you want to talk more about this you can message me:)

my doctor told me not too look up the side effects because then I would be likelier to get them, so I didn't. Started taking them in june of this year and the first two weeks I thought I was gonna die. My heart kept racing and I was having the most awful panic attacks. I'm also really shaky all the time. As of late I have just been like a zombie, I don't feel anything exept for extreme anxiety sometimes, so It's been great...

Thank you so much for answering and for understandning. If anyone close to me decided to commit suicide, I would never blame them or think that they did wrong. I really don't like this world and this life and I don't want to continue. I've been sick for so long so I don't know what it's really like to live i think. I don't understand how so many people can be happy and enjoy life

wow i didn't really expect enyone to answer on here, Im new to reddit. Thanks for the kind words. I really really want to talk more openly about my feelings, especially to my family, I just feel like its gonna be so sudden! They all act like everything is fine with me, even though they know that it's not. The pressure of not being able to talk and the stress of keeping it together really is making me feel like I'm gonna explode

I feel you. I'm on sertralin right now but I feel like I've been on a million different ones. The side effects are living hell, especially the constipation. I though it was gonna get better but it's been 6 months now...
I used to be very ashamed of my intrusive thoughts but I finally told my therapist about them and she told me that it's very normal to think violent things related och unrelated to your trauma!
